name: Trigger 1
description: When Counting-section passengers/day exceeds 12,000 passenger-trips/day for 2 consecutive years, decide to build; open after a 6-year lead time.

name: Trigger 2
description: When PT share of trips exceeds 0.22 trip share (0-1) for 2 consecutive years, decide to build; open after a 10-year lead time.
